items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: Well, I married my childhood sweetheart. I met her when she was 11 and I was 13

ctx.x: and Willie Bryant's band Calloway, and Lucky's band -- we should get over to family. You mentioned here where you married at 19 years old, so you got to tell me who you married now.

Well, I married my childhood sweetheart. I met her when she was 11 and I was 13 -- I was playing in the school band at football games, and that's how I met my wife, my first wife, Helen. Her name was Helen Dean at the time.
